readme.details: Starter dataset for building and demonstrating the Mumbai FloodPulse urban flood-risk prototype.

All rainfall values, historical incident counts, drainage proxies, elevations, risk scores and risk levels in the main dataset are synthetic or illustrative. They are NOT verified historical observations and must not be presented as real Mumbai flood data.
Approximate demonstration coordinates for mapping the broad Mumbai urban area; not verified street-level or ward-level boundaries.
2025-07-01 through 2025-07-30, generated for demo purposes only.
No verified observed-flood labels are included. 'NOT_AVAILABLE' is deliberate. Do not train/evaluate a flood classifier using the synthetic risk level as if it were ground truth.

Illustrative weighted index only: 45% rainfall indicator, 25% synthetic historical incident indicator, 20% synthetic terrain indicator, 10% inverse synthetic drainage proxy, plus small synthetic noise. It is not a calibrated flood probability.
Use to prototype dashboard layouts, map layers, preprocessing, scenario controls and code paths. Replace synthetic fields with sourced, documented data before making evidence-based claims.

BMC Disaster Management: https://dm.mcgm.gov.in/ ; IMD: https://mausam.imd.gov.in/ ; India Open Government Data: https://www.data.gov.in/ ; OpenCity: https://data.opencity.in/ ; NASA Earthdata: https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/
Random generator seed = 42. Dataset created by a deterministic script for this response.
Generated synthetic data may be reused for prototyping. Any external source data added later must retain its own licence and attribution.
